text:
ali (mktg): SpruceField interview confirmed Mon 9:30am PT. Need: 1-line quote, logo permission, and OK on a short customer clip by Thu EOD so we can lock launch post + webinar in 10 days.

dom (content): I'll draft two lead lines (numeric and soft). Draft numeric: "Redwood reduced our per-request cost by ~60% while keeping latency stable." Will prep alt wording.

rachel (legal): If you include the 60% figure we need a written attestation and the customer's signoff on final copy. Also request their logo guidelines. If attestation delayed, we should use non-numeric phrasing.

owen (sales): I'll ask AE to secure attestation and logo permissions. Also check with SpruceField about a 30s video soundbite.

tia (demand): Promo plan: 1 launch post, 2 LinkedIn cards, and a segmented email to Ops list. Open regs same time as announcement at 8:30am PT. Need approved quote + logo by Thu to approve creative.

marco (ops): HubSpot routing: add hidden `source=case_webinar` and `priority_demo` checkbox. Rule: priority_demo==true -> AE-Priority (48h), else -> nurture. I'll implement Wed AM.

upload-bot: Recording/transcript links will be posted after the interview to drive: https://drive.redwood/sprucefield/

ali (mktg): Quick actions: 1) Owen: attestation/logo (today) 2) Dom: two copy variants (Wed AM) 3) Rachel: legal review (Thu EOD) 4) Marco: HubSpot fields + routing (Wed AM) 5) Tia: lock promo once assets approved. Tag @rachel for any legal redlines. :thumbsup:

dom (content): I'll include both CTA variants on the landing page: "Read benchmark details" and "Book a priority demo" for A/B test.

rachel (legal): Agreed on embargo until we get explicit signoff email from SpruceField including logo use and quote text. I'll draft approval checklist for them to sign.

owen (sales): On it. If attestation isn't ready, give the green light to use the softer phrasing to keep schedule.

ali (mktg): Perfect. I'll update the interview doc and share the calendar invite with recording notes. Thanks everyone.
